selection: Whole-donor cross-validation primary mean donor MAE. Select smallest coefficient count within 1% of minimum development error, then error. >=5 substantive attempts; continue until two no-gain attempts and no supported next hypothesis.
calibration: One LSS30kPa assay value per donor, given equally to all models. This is a calibrated condition-response diagnostic, not unmeasured-donor prediction.
target_transformation: Per-sample library-depth CPM and log2(1+CPM); deterministic, no across-sample learned preprocessing
gene_selection: Entrez7412 VCAM1 selected from source publication before count inspection
exposure: Only identifiers, shape and covariates inspected prefit; no VCAM1 count values or confirmation outcomes displayed
groups: Whole donors; calibration and all condition rows linked. One reserved donor, three leave-one-donor-out folds.
identifiability: Effective condition response only; three stiffness levels do not identify a unique mechanotransduction pathway.
